risk_description: Due to the contact of the fuel line with the bodywork and plastic parts, there may be a possibility of a fuel leak at the rear of the vehicle. This could lead to loss of contact with the road or road users near the vehicle could slip, increasing the risk of an accident.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
